title: Check if the Sentence Is Pangram
description: A pangram is a sentence in which every letter of the English alphabet (`'a'` through `'z'`) appears at least once. Given a lowercase string `sentence`, return `true` if `sentence` is a pangram, and `false` otherwise.
constraints: sentence consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: Track seen letters using a 26-bit integer bitmask.
Return true as soon as the mask equals (1 << 26) - 1.

examples.explanation: "leetcode" is missing most letters of the alphabet.
